info.name: experience_1 Full API Verification
info.description:
Generated collection for the currently mounted experience_1 routes under /api/v1/main.

Use `npm run postman:generate` in `experience_1` to refresh this file.

This collection mirrors the repo-native smoke runner and persists the IDs, OTP sessions, and auth tokens needed across the auth, onboarding, settings, rates, package, appointment, speciality, user type, and permission flows.

item.name: Health
item.description: Health checks for the experience_1 API, database, and Redis connection.

request.description: Confirm that the app, database, and Redis are up before running dependent flows.
